title: Chapter 5: Ancient & Medieval History of Bengal

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Shashanka was the first major independent ruler of ancient Bengal, ruling from his capital at Karnasuvarna.
Gopala established the Pala Dynasty around 750 AD, ending a period of extreme political instability known as Matsyanyaya.
The Pala rulers were major patrons of Mahayana Buddhism, founding great monastic universities like Vikramashila and Somapura.
The Sena Dynasty succeeded the Palas in the 12th century, bringing a revival of orthodox Hinduism and Sanskrit literature.
Shamsuddin Iliyas Shah unified Bengal into an independent Sultanate in 1352 AD, establishing a distinct Bengali regional identity.

[EXAM TIP] Battle of Plassey (23 June 1757) is the single most important historical date for WB exams. It marked the beginning of British rule in India. Siraj-ud-Daulah was betrayed by Mir Jafar.
